description_zh: 调用DeleteRouteEntries批量删除自定义路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --route-entries DstCidrBlock=47.100.XX.XX/24 RouteEntryId=rte-bp1mnnr2al0naomnpv0000 RouteTableId=vtb-2ze3jgygk9bmsj23s0000 NextHop=i-j6c2fp57q8rr4jlu0000 --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the route table resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由表所属地域的ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the route table that contains the route entry to delete. You can specify up to 50 route table IDs
element_fields.help_zh: 要删除的路由条目所在的路由表的ID。最多支持输入50个路由表ID
element_fields.name: route_table_id

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the route entry to delete. You can specify up to 50 route entry IDs.

> If the **RouteEntryId** parameter is not specified, the **DstCidrBlock** and **NextHop** parameters are required
element_fields.help_zh:
要删除的路由条目ID。最多支持输入50个路由条目ID。

> 当**RouteEntryId**参数未输入时，**DstCidrBlock**和**NextHop**参数必填
element_fields.name: route_entry_id

element_fields.help_en:
The destination CIDR block of the route entry to delete. IPv4 CIDR blocks, IPv6 CIDR blocks, and prefix list CIDR blocks are supported. You can specify up to 50 destination CIDR blocks.

> If the **RouteEntryId** parameter is not specified, the **DstCidrBlock** and **NextHop** parameters are required
element_fields.help_zh:
要删除的路由条目的目标网段，支持IPv4网段、IPv6网段和前缀列表网段。最多支持输入50个目标网段。

> 当**RouteEntryId**参数未输入时，**DstCidrBlock**和**NextHop**参数必填
element_fields.name: dst_cidr_block

element_fields.help_en:
The ID of the next hop instance to delete. You can specify up to 50 instance IDs.

> If the **RouteEntryId** parameter is not specified, the **DstCidrBlock** and **NextHop** parameters are required
element_fields.help_zh:
要删除的下一跳实例的ID。最多支持输入50个实例ID。

> 当**RouteEntryId**参数未输入时，**DstCidrBlock**和**NextHop**参数必填
element_fields.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en: The information about the route entries to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的路由条目信息
parameters.name: route_entries

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

**true**: performs a dry run without deleting routes. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

**false** (default): sends a normal request. If the check passes, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the routes are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

**true**：发送请求，不会删除路由条目。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

**false**（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并直接删除路由条目
parameters.name: dry_run
